5059de6416d9c96c6b76af6d06daf6b1d1800e7a.sourceText: **斜坡也可以是一张平整的斜面。** 源码没有用这项限制面的倾斜角，所以它不是最大坡度，也不是“高出地面10 cm就禁止通行”的障碍门槛；后者属于地形与代价地图的判断。
5059de6416d9c96c6b76af6d06daf6b1d1800e7a.translatedText: **The slope may also be a flat inclined plane\.** The source code does not use this to constrain the inclination angle of the surface, so it is neither a maximum slope nor the obstacle threshold of "prohibiting passage when 10 cm above the ground"; the latter belongs to the judgment of the terrain and costmap\.

5081e640a478befcd6abfebcd3e367f2d2c0c228.translatedText: `localization_launch.py` After the parameter file, additionally pass in `{"prior_pcd_file": prior_pcd_file}`\.
